core: Cell cycle phase transitions and checkpoints
qualifier: RB/DREAM repression of E2F targets and G2/M control
name: Cell cycle checkpoints, G2/M control and RB–E2F repression
rationale: All members concern cyclin-CDK-driven G1/S and G2/M transitions and their checkpoints; unlike the p53/DNA-damage confusables and the activating E2F-target confusables, the theme combines RB/p107/p130/DREAM repression of E2F with G2/M kinase events (PLK, MASTL, Chk1/2).

qualifier: phagocytosis and inhibitory immunoreceptor signaling (CD22, SIRP)
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and inhibitory immunoreceptor signaling
rationale: Members cover IgG Fc-gamma receptor activation, phagocytic cup formation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity plus inhibitory receptors restraining B cells, neutrophils and phagocytosis, distinguishing it from Fc-epsilon/mast cell and generic myeloid confusables.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and distal segment differentiation
name: Nephron segment patterning and distal tubule development
rationale: All members describe nephron formation from renal vesicle through comma/S-shaped bodies to patterned tubule segments, and the theme alone has distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct development rather than nephric duct, ureteric bud or intermediate mesoderm.

qualifier: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase pathway deficiencies
name: Cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase deficiencies
rationale: Members concern intracellular cobalamin metabolism feeding propionyl-CoA catabolism, with MUT, MMAA, MMAB and CD320 defects causing methylmalonic aciduria, whereas confusables cover cobalamin absorption/transport or combined MMACHC/MMADHC disorders.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: myeloid and early erythroid commitment
name: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor regulation with myeloid–erythroid commitment
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, homeostasis and differentiation, myeloid progenitor and primitive/definitive erythroid differentiation, distinguishing it from late erythroid/megakaryocyte, B-lineage and stem-maintenance confusables.

qualifier: linkage-specific chain editing by deubiquitinase families
name: Deubiquitinase families and K48/K63/K11 ubiquitin chain editing
rationale: Members concern deubiquitinase classes (USP, OTU, metalloprotease) and K48/K63/K11 linkage-specific removal or regulation of ubiquitin chains, unlike confusables on NF-kB regulation, atypical chain assembly or neddylation.

core: Axon extension, sprouting and regeneration control
qualifier: Sema3A–plexin and netrin repulsive signaling
name: Sema3A and netrin repulsion in axon growth and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate axon guidance, extension, collateral sprouting and regeneration chiefly through Sema3A-plexin and netrin repulsion, whereas confusables center on ephrin, SLIT-ROBO, L1 adhesion and DCC attraction.

core: Repression of RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription
qualifier: nucleolar chromatin silencing involving SIRT1
name: Nucleolar chromatin repression of RNA polymerase I transcription
rationale: All three members concern silencing of rDNA transcription by RNA polymerase I via nucleolar chromatin (SIRT1), distinct from confusables on Pol I initiation, elongation, termination and rRNA processing.

core: Th2 differentiation and type 2 cytokine production
qualifier: IgE class switching and mast cell activation
name: Th2 polarization, type 2 cytokine production and IgE switching
rationale: Members regulate Th2 differentiation, IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production, IgE isotype switching and mast cell cytokine output, distinguishing it from eosinophil, Fc-epsilon receptor and IL-4/IL-13 receptor signaling confusables.

qualifier: inhibition of fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation
name: Platelet activation and antifibrinolytic control of plasminogen activation
rationale: Members combine platelet activation/degranulation with negative regulation of fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation, which separates the theme from coagulation-cascade, platelet-aggregation and ECM confusables.

qualifier: initiation and its negative regulation
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and its negative regulation
rationale: Members concern initiation of S-phase DNA replication, its restraint and E2F1-driven replication genes, unlike confusables on E2F transcription networks, pre-replicative complex assembly or replication-stress checkpoints.

qualifier: hepatic SLCO uptake, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export defects
name: Heme-derived bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole degradation and hepatic organic anion uptake, glucuronidation and export of bilirubin with their hyperbilirubinemia defects, distinct from drug ADME and xenobiotic transport confusables.

qualifier: export of mature mRNA, ribosomal subunits and tRNA
name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA, ribosomal subunits and tRNA
rationale: Members concern RNA traffic through the nuclear pore, chiefly mature mRNA, ribosomal subunit and tRNA export, whereas confusables cover mRNA 3'-end processing or nuclear pore assembly and non-RNA cargo.

core: NOTCH receptor activation and signal transmission
qualifier: NOTCH1/NOTCH2 and oncogenic constitutive NOTCH1 mutants
name: NOTCH1/NOTCH2 activation and oncogenic constitutive NOTCH1 signaling
rationale: Members describe NOTCH1/NOTCH2 activation, intracellular-domain signaling and constitutively active NOTCH1 or FBXW7-loss cancer variants, unlike confusables centered on NOTCH3/NOTCH4 and HLH target transcription.

core: Glandular epithelial morphogenesis of reproductive organs
qualifier: mammary, prostate and genital tract
name: Mammary, prostate and genital tract epithelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover mammary lineages and branching, prostate bud and acinus morphogenesis and uterus, vagina, oviduct and genitalia development, distinguishing it from lung/salivary branching, gonad determination and kidney confusables.

core: Congenital disorders of glycosylation type I
qualifier: ALG glycosyltransferase steps of lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly
name: ALG glycosyltransferase defects in lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly
rationale: All members are CDG-I caused by defective ALG enzymes that extend the dolichol-linked N-glycan precursor, unlike confusables involving GDP-mannose/dolichol-phosphate-mannose supply or Golgi CDG-II enzymes.

qualifier: growth plate proliferation and hypertrophic maturation
name: Growth plate chondrocyte proliferation and hypertrophic maturation
rationale: All members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and RUNX2-driven hypertrophy in the growth plate, whereas confusables concern cartilage condensation, osteoblasts and bone formation.

qualifier: odorant and pheromone receptors
name: Olfactory receptor-mediated odorant and pheromone detection
rationale: All members concern olfactory receptor expression and sensing of odorants and pheromones, distinguishing the theme from taste perception confusables.

qualifier: 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin and cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase routes
name: 12-lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 oxygenation of polyunsaturated fatty acids
rationale: Members cover 12-LOX/hepoxilin, epoxygenase (EET) and omega-hydroxylase (HETE) metabolism of arachidonic/linoleic acid including epidermal-barrier defects, unlike confusables on 5/15-LOX leukotrienes or other CYP disorders.

qualifier: BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function defects
name: Homology-directed double-strand break repair and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects
rationale: Members span end resection, RAD51 strand exchange, D-loop resolution and SSA with BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects, distinguishing it from NHEJ, MMEJ and DSB-sensing confusables.

qualifier: renal Na+/Pi cotransport and FGFR1c–Klotho signaling
name: Phosphate homeostasis via renal Na+/Pi cotransport and FGFR1c–Klotho
rationale: Members concern type II Na+/Pi cotransporters (SLC34A1/A3) and their defects with FGFR1c-Klotho, PTH and mineralization regulation, unlike vitamin D, dentin or lung SLC34A2 confusables.

qualifier: ductal branching, alveologenesis and lactation
name: Mammary ductal branching, alveologenesis and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary epithelial proliferation, ductal branching, alveolar development and lactation, whereas confusables emphasize luminal, myoepithelial and stem lineages or involution.

qualifier: inherited methionine-cycle enzyme defects
name: Methionine–S-adenosylmethionine cycle and its inherited defects
rationale: Members cover methionine and SAM metabolism with MAT1A, AHCY, MTR and MTRR deficiencies, unlike folate, choline/carnitine and methionine salvage or selenium confusables.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 with inflammatory chemokine production
name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory chemokine production
rationale: Members combine NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-driven IL-1 precursor processing with regulation of IL-1 alpha and CXCL1/CXCL2/CCL3/CCL5 production, distinct from caspase-4/5 pyroptosis, IL-18/IL-17 and TLR confusables.

core: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and volume
qualifier: angiotensin and bradykinin peptide processing with renal sodium handling
name: Renin–angiotensin peptide processing and renal blood volume control
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signaling, bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism, natriuretic cGMP signaling and renal sodium and volume regulation of pressure, unlike NO-cGMP vascular and smooth-muscle confusables.
